objective: Replace the oracle coefficient reads at MLP0 and MLP1 with a frozen, sequential, executable low-rank affine tensor program and measure its causal fidelity on untouched FineWeb documents.
scope_guardrail: This experiment may fit two isolated coefficient predictors, but may not update the base model, the deployed ship, or the admitted rank-64 bases. It does not amend the v3 basis artifact's authorized_for_training=false field and does not turn the v3 discovery or heldout rows into training data. A pass licenses only an in-distribution executable early-MLP interface on the frozen ship realization, not whole-model reverse engineering, OOD generalization, minimality, production training, or a globally simplest program.

training_authority.basis_artifact_rule: The admitted v3 bases are read-only coordinate systems. They are never refit, rotated, sign-normalized, or optimized.
training_authority.isolated_fit_rule: The current project directive authorizes fitting new standalone maps only on the fresh compiler_fit rows below. No prior v3 basis, discovery, or heldout row is a predictor-fit row.
training_authority.licensed_parameters: Only the two affine coefficient maps, their train-only normalization constants, and their canonical low-rank factors.
training_authority.forbidden_parameters: Base-model weights, ship weights, output bases, token tables, position tables, cached labels, row-index tables, and background-specific maps.

pinned_inputs.basis_coordinate_rule: Use the serialized float32 tensors byte-for-byte.

fresh_rows.source: Pinned first parquet of the ordered FineWeb default train manifest, using the already certified local source identity and census-prefix-dedup/tokenization semantics.
required_gates: Every split has row-aligned document/chunk provenance.
The three new roles are pairwise document-disjoint, full-row-disjoint, and prefix-32-disjoint.
Every new role is document-disjoint from all ship_fit, basis, discovery, and heldout documents in fineweb_oracle_v2_receipt.json.
The final split is never used for fitting, rank/lambda choice, stopping, grammar choice, thresholds, or debugging.
The row receipt is written and content-addressed before any predictor label is captured.

estimand.live_input: z_l is the post-attention RMS-normalized input actually seen at MLP l under the frozen deployed ship plus any already-applied predicted upstream correction.
estimand.label: c_l(z_l) = (f_l_original(z_l) - f_l_ship(z_l)) @ B_l, with original and ship evaluated on the identical live z_l.
estimand.capture_positions: 64::3 over the 256 model-input positions, used only for predictor fitting and local validation diagnostics.
estimand.causal_currency: Paired row-level end-to-end cross entropy on positions 64: of compiler_final, clustered by source document.

grammar.input_normalization: mu and per-coordinate RMS sigma are computed on compiler_fit only; sigma is clamped below at 1e-6.
grammar.ridge_objective: For centered targets, minimize mean squared coefficient error plus lambda times squared Frobenius norm of the full affine weight.
grammar.factorization: For each lambda, take the deterministic float64 SVD of the 1152x64 ridge weight, truncate to each registered rank, and serialize the balanced canonical factors A=U*sqrt(S), C=sqrt(S)*Vh. Fix each singular-vector pair's sign by making its largest-absolute A entry positive.
grammar.selection: On compiler_validation only, choose the least standalone-priced candidate whose coefficient NMSE is at most 1.01 times the minimum validation NMSE. Break remaining ties by smaller rank, larger lambda, then lexicographic candidate order.
grammar.artifact_contents: For each site: mu, sigma, b, balanced A/C factors, selected rank/lambda, basis hash binding, fit/validation receipts, and pricing. No original weights, clean activations, labels, token IDs, position IDs, row indices, or cached per-example values.

sequential_fit.step_1: Fit and freeze g0 on deployed-MLP0 compiler_fit states; choose rank/lambda on deployed-MLP0 compiler_validation states.
sequential_fit.step_2: Run the frozen ship with the frozen g0 correction actually applied. Capture the resulting live MLP1 compiler_fit/validation states and labels, then fit and freeze exactly one g1.
forbidden: teacher-forced original or oracle MLP0 states for g1
sequential_fit.reuse: The same frozen g0 and g1 are reused under every N/Q/O neighbor and N/E MLP2 background.

controls.mean: Per-site train mean coefficient, rolled out sequentially and frozen.
controls.document_shuffle: A deterministic seed-271828 document-block permutation of fit labels, with the identical affine grammar, lambda/rank search, data budget, and sequential rollout rule.
controls.oracle: O uses the live exact residual projected into the same fixed B_l and is a ceiling/control only.
controls.teacher_forcing_shadow: Optional and nonprimary: a separately priced g1 fit on O0 states may be reported only as a local failure diagnostic and can never substitute for the autoregressive g1.

evaluation.primary_lattice: Complete 3x3x2 lattice {N,Q,O}x{N,Q,O}x{N,E}, 18 arms, plus joint mean and joint shuffled controls at MLP2=N.
evaluation.poison_rule: For every scored arm, original MLP0/1 forward calls are replaced by raise-on-call poison unless that exact site is O. All N/Q-only arms, including QQN and QQE, must finish with both original-call counters equal to zero. MLP2 original is allowed only in E arms.
evaluation.hook_rule: Use an isolated correction hook with strict install/clear/restore canaries; do not mutate ship_error_attrib.py or reuse its ORACLE_CORR/CONTENT_CORR state as predictor storage.
evaluation.statistics: Paired document-cluster bootstrap with 2000 draws and fixed seeds 31415926 onward. Recompute maxima, oracle denominators, ratios, and nonlinear margins inside each draw.
report: global, copy, novel-frequent, and novel-rare CE

registered_gates.integrity: All pins, fresh-row disjointness, artifact freeze, component-tree, replay, source-closure, hook-clear, and original-call poison gates pass.
registered_gates.core_no_free_rider: All eight Q-site effects over N/Q neighbor x N/E MLP2 backgrounds have positive point estimates and document-cluster 95% lower bounds above zero.
registered_gates.oracle_neighbor_reuse: The four additional Q-site effects with an O neighbor have positive point estimates and 95% lower bounds above zero; failure demotes the result to a sequential package rather than modular sites.
registered_gates.same_background_fidelity: Every core Q effect is at least 0.50 of its positive same-background O effect, with the 0.50 margin and denominator recomputed within every bootstrap draw and a 95% lower bound above zero.
registered_gates.composition: QQN-max(QNN,NQN)>0 and QQE-max(QNE,NQE,NNE)>0, both with 95% lower bounds above zero.
registered_gates.joint_fidelity: (QQN-NNN)-0.50*(OON-NNN)>0 and (QQE-NNE)-0.50*(OOE-NNE)>0, both with positive oracle references and 95% lower bounds above zero.
registered_gates.controls: QQN beats both joint-mean-N and joint-shuffled-N in paired CE with 95% lower bounds above zero.
registered_gates.collateral: QQ causes no copy or novel-frequent CE worsening greater than 0.01 nats relative to the matched deployed arm.
registered_gates.mlp2_compatibility_diagnostic: Report QQE-QQN and its interval, but do not make it conjunctive because the admitted v3 downstream rescue was only +0.0194 nats with a +0.0002 lower bound.

failure_localization.single_site_failure: The causal subspace is real but its coordinates are not locally predictable with this affine grammar.
failure_localization.QON_rescues_QQN: The MLP1 predictor is the main bottleneck.
failure_localization.OQN_works_QQN_fails: Predicted-MLP0 exposure shift is the main bottleneck.
failure_localization.high_local_R2_causal_failure: Euclidean coefficient loss misses downstream-sensitive error directions.
failure_localization.mean_or_shuffle_matches_Q: The apparent benefit is regularization or average correction, not extracted computation.
failure_localization.affine_failure: Reject only the affine coefficient grammar; next registered rung is a native bilinear-product or paired-product tensor program.

pricing.precision: Report float32 storage and an explicit 16-bit counterfactual; do not assume entropy coding without serializing a code.
pricing.standalone: Count B_l, mu_l, sigma_l, b_l, both balanced factors, metadata/indices, and any quantizer/codebook.
pricing.amortized: May omit B_l only under the explicit admitted-basis-library assumption; all other predictor state is counted.
pricing.original_comparator: Price restoration of the original MLP0/1 bilinear modules on the same ship substrate, including 4608 Hadamard products and all Left/Right/Down weights per site.
pricing.gauge_rule: For orthogonal B->B R, transport output coordinates/factors and require bit-identical physical corrections within tolerance, identical CE, and unchanged balanced-factor price.

next_rung_if_affine_fails: Preregister activation-aware native hidden-product truncation or learned paired products, with product count as the main algebraic complexity coordinate and with the same fresh-row, sequential, poison, lattice, and control contract.
